timeline.subtitle: The chunkiest model in the paddock
timeline.narration: Ladies and gentlemen, prepare to meet the absolute unit of AI models. This... is Mistral Le Chonk!

timeline.heading: Why is Le Chonk so round?
items: Generous proportions: chunky layers, maximum coziness
Zero fat trimming: open weights, nothing shaved off
Hibernation mode: runs efficiently at room temperature
timeline.narration: Why is Le Chonk so gloriously round? Chunky layers for maximum coziness. Open weights, with absolutely nothing shaved off. And yes, it hibernates! It runs efficiently at room temperature.

timeline.heading: Chonk density scale (science)
timeline.narration: Scientists measured it, and the results are in. On the official chonk density scale, Le Chonk doesn't just top the chart. It IS the chart. Eleven chonk units, and climbing!

timeline.heading: Le Chonk in the wild
items: Naps directly on the GPU — keeps it warm
Eats tokens in one bite, never crumbs
Purr-formance mode: activates on head scratches

timeline.narration: Where do you find Le Chonk in the wild? Napping directly on the GPU, keeping it warm and cozy. Eating entire tokens in one bite, never leaving crumbs. And in purr-formance mode, it activates with head scratches!
Stay chonky, my friends. Le Chonk approved this video.
